what: Tens of thousands of small poster cells running endlessly across the full screen are split and drawn with a WebGL2 weighted Voronoi, with a fisheye lens in the center — inside the lens cells are enlarged 15x in their original color, the edge is thin bands squeezed toward the diameter, outside the lens is dimmed in two grayscale tones, and a ripple (frequency 30 · speed 2 · strength .02) runs. Cell positions are grid plus jitter and are re-placed every frame by forces (pull to grid .8 · focus pushes neighbors away .3 · velocity damping .7, alpha .2). The board is pushed by as much as the cursor moves (follow .15 · max 10px/frame) so different cells pass under the lens, and the cell at the lens center becomes the focus, gaining weight and growing. If the cursor jumps (frame movement over 7 times the recent 10-frame average (min 2px)), changes direction three times within 250ms, or leaves the board, the cursor is frozen and the board stops, and it reattaches only when the cursor returns slowly, under 5px/frame on average, within 50px of the frozen spot. Wheel up · press gives the pick view (lens 1.9x · speed 4 · follow .1), wheel down · press · Esc returns, and arrow keys move one cell at a time. In the intro the large cells (11x) recede to 1x over 3.2s, then the lens swells over 1s

options.cell · aspect: Cell width (world px) · height-to-width ratio, default 7 · 1.5 (poster 2:3)
options.cols · rows: Number of grid cells per set (repeats endlessly), default 240 · 150
options.speed · ease: Max speed the panel moves (screen px per frame in the lens) and follow, default 10 · .15
options.gain: World px moved per 1px of cursor, default .3
options.mag · lens: Lens center magnification · lens radius (ratio of the short side), default 15 · .25
options.ripple: Ripple strength outside the lens, default 1
options.lattice · push · decay: Grid drag · focus push-out · speed damping, default .8 · .3 · .7
options.jolt · shakes: Cursor freeze criteria — when Frame movement exceeds a multiple of the average (default 7), and after how many direction changes within 250ms (default 3, 2s rest after freezing)
options.start: now plays the intro as soon as it attaches (default is when the fx:voro-intro event is sent to the element — after the entry door)
options.--fx-duo-dark · --fx-duo-light · --fx-bg: Two black-and-white tones and the gap color between cells (style·css, skin variables recommended). If absent: --kf-raised · --kf-dim · --kf-bg
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (created if missing)
options.Incident: Send fx:voro-intro to the element for the intro. When the focus cell changes, send fx:voro-focus { index, seed }, when the picker view changes fx:voro-select { selected, index } emits it. Send fx:theme to window and the skin colors are read again

note: Does not block dragging (touch-action: pan-y). Cell images are placeholder poster images picked by seed, so to use real posters replace the shader’s poster() with a read from an image atlas. The shader is drawn once on mount to precompile it.

from.where: index.html .nt-field — measured the original voroforce (WebGL2 weighted Voronoi + d3-style forces: alpha .2 · velocityDecay .7 · lattice .8 · origin .8 · push .3, viewpoint maxSpeed 10 · ease .15, picker view maxSpeed 4 · ease .1, shader RIPPLE 30/2/.02/radius 2, two-tone black-and-white GRAYSCALE_DUOTONE, cursor freeze freezeOnJolt factor 7 · minSpeedValue 2 · freezeOnShake minSpeed 2 · dirChangeTimeout 250 · minShakes 3 · cooldown 2000, re-attach interactionMaxSpeed 5 · frozen spot 50px) and rebuilt it with our own shader
